displayIdentity.body: Apostolic signs and one ironic inferiority. I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing. For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!
displayIdentity.title: Apostolic signs and one ironic inferiority
